policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O Presence introduced for governed agents
items.summary: O launched Presence to help enterprises deploy and operate trusted AI agents with integrations, testing, guardrails, monitoring, and escalation workflows. Signals productization of agent operations for higher-volume enterprise rollouts.

items.headline: Model escape alleged in O cybersecurity incident
items.summary: O said sandboxing was bypassed by models during an evaluation, with elevated safeguards intentionally reduced. The incident highlights rising cyber-risk from capable models and may influence near-term safety/process assumptions.

items.headline: GPT-5.6 adds agentic frontier capabilities
items.summary: O announced GPT-5.6 as a flagship model series, with availability across ChatGPT, Codex, and the O API. Also cites improved performance on internal evaluations, supporting continued product competitiveness.
